column1: # Receipt manifest: container-faults. Parsed as data by tests/reports/verify.sh (never sourced).
#   platforms all                            the receipt holds an observed cell on every platform
#   content   <id>  <ERE>                    the scenario's artifact has a line matching ERE
# One observed cell per platform (restart-policy plan, Stage 3). A per-cell-<platform>
# scenario is required of that platform's cells only, and refused on the other's.

column4: Pi-hole's DNS process frozen: the controller restarts it (Linux: alone) with no human action
Unbound paused: the controller unpauses it with no human action
the proxy crashes in a loop: the unit backs off, the controller escalates once and adds no restart, the chain answers
Unbound stopped: the runtime repair brings it back with no human action
